metricExplanations.Output_item_message_duration: Output duration from first delta to done for message items

metricExplanations.Output_item_other_duration: Output duration from first delta to done for other output items
metricExplanations.Time_to_first_reasoning_token: Time to output the first token (reasoning_content/reasoning field)
metricExplanations.Time_to_reasoning_completion: Generation time for the reasoning part
metricExplanations.Input_tokens: Number of input tokens (prompt tokens) per request
metricExplanations.Completion_tokens: Number of output tokens (completion tokens) per request
metricExplanations.Time_to_first_event: Time from A2A task submit to the first protocol event
metricExplanations.TTFE: Latency from issuing tool call to receiving the first parseable response event; for non-streaming JSON, this is when the complete response becomes parseable
metricExplanations.End_to_end: Total client-observed latency from issuing tool call until the response is fully received and parsed

statisticExplanations.RPS: Number of requests sent per second
statisticExplanations.TTFE (s): Time from submit to the first protocol event (s)
statisticExplanations.Total TPS (tokens/s): Number of input and generated tokens per second
statisticExplanations.Completion TPS (tokens/s): Number of generated tokens per second
statisticExplanations.Avg. Total TPR (tokens/req): Average number of input and generated tokens per request
statisticExplanations.Avg. Completion TPR (tokens/req): Average number of generated tokens per request
statisticExplanations.Task Submission Rate: Total SendMessage and SendStreamingMessage submission requests divided by effective test duration in seconds
statisticExplanations.Task Acceptance Rate: Submissions returning a protocol-valid Task or direct Message divided by all submission attempts; indicates acceptance only, not task completion
statisticExplanations.Terminal Task Throughput: Tasks entering completed, failed, canceled, or rejected divided by effective test duration in seconds
statisticExplanations.Completed Task Throughput: Tasks ending in completed divided by effective test duration in seconds; equals terminal task throughput times terminal task completion rate, counting only successfully completed tasks
statisticExplanations.Terminal Task Completion Rate: Tasks ending in completed divided by all terminal tasks; direct Message responses are excluded
statisticExplanations.Terminal Task Failure Rate: Tasks ending in failed divided by all terminal tasks; canceled and rejected remain distinct terminal outcomes
statisticExplanations.Composite Failure Rate: (failed A2A protocol requests + tasks ending in failed) / (all A2A protocol requests + all terminal tasks); a composite protocol-and-task reliability metric, not the complement of task acceptance rate
statisticExplanations.Cascade Amplification: Internal MCP calls observed per observable top-level task
statisticExplanations.End-to-end Latency: Average time from A2A task submit to a terminal state
statisticExplanations.Tool Call Success Rate: Successful tool call operations divided by all tool call operations; success requires a valid transport and JSON-RPC response, no protocol error, and CallToolResult.isError not set to true
statisticExplanations.Tool Call Request Rate: Total tool call requests divided by effective test duration in seconds; represents offered load
statisticExplanations.Tool Call Throughput: Completed tool call requests divided by effective test duration in seconds; includes successful and failed calls
statisticExplanations.Successful Tool Call Throughput: Successful tool call requests divided by effective test duration in seconds
statisticExplanations.TPS (tokens/s): Output tokens per second; calculated only when a token path is configured and observed
statisticExplanations.Content Throughput (B/s): Total MCP content bytes returned by successful tool call operations divided by effective test duration in seconds
